summary: Maxeon Solar Technologies, Ltd. (under judicial management) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a non-exclusive intellectual property license agreement. On May 22, 2026, subsidiary MSPL licensed patents and trade secrets to controlling shareholder TZE HK for an $8 million fee paid in full. The license has a 6-year renewable term, covers past releases, and survives change of control or insolvency. While related to a distressed issuer, this is a routine licensing contract, not a special situation. What to watch: potential further restructuring or asset sales by the judicial manager.
